messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-10-07] incident-review/INC-2025-023: Incident review INC-2025-023. The indexer served stale results for two days on 2025-10-03. Root cause: a reindex job that failed silently on a full disk. Decision: reindex jobs will page on failure, because a silent reindex failure left stale results for two days in INC-2025-023.
- [2025-04-22] standup/cinder/2025-04-22: The search indexer is pinned to OpenSearch 2.11; the pin lifts when the full reindex completes.
- [2025-12-18] standup/atlas/2025-12-18: Decided in today's standup: search-indexer will rebuild the index nightly instead of on every catalog write, since incremental updates left stale entries behind after failed writes.
- [2025-01-30] standup/cinder/2025-01-30: If the catalog service is down, the search indexer is down: it relies on it for product documents.
- [2026-05-27] standup/atlas/2026-05-27: Decided in today's standup: the event-bus will retain messages for seven days, since replaying a full week has covered every incident recovery so far. The Atlas team noticed that search-indexer's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. The catalog still relies on the resizer; keep that in mind for the maintenance.
- [2025-05-20] handover/2025-05-20-search-indexer: Team Atlas is taking over search-indexer from team Cinder, effective today. Dashboards and alerts are being repointed.
- [2025-05-30] incident-review/INC-2025-011: Review of INC-2025-011 (Ledger, 2025-05-24). The root cause was an index missing after the schema migration. We decided that ledger migrations will ship with a reviewed query plan, because a missing index after a migration caused INC-2025-011.
- [2026-06-09] standup/dune/2026-06-09: Observation from team Dune: after the retention change, search-indexer's disk usage jumped 30 percent.
- [2026-02-10] standup/boreal/2026-02-10-2: Team Boreal noticed that the indexer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.
- [2026-05-19] incident-review/INC-2026-009: Incident review INC-2026-009. The scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-16. Root cause: two leaders elected during a network partition. Decision: the scheduler leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds, because two leaders ran the nightly jobs twice in INC-2026-009.
- [2026-04-01] handover/2026-04-01-search-indexer: From today the pager for the search indexer rings the Boreal team, not team Atlas. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-01-17] standup/cinder/2025-01-17-2: For the record, the indexer is owned by Cinder.
- [2025-10-15] standup/atlas/2025-10-15: Team Atlas noticed that the image resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.
- [2026-04-08] standup/atlas/2026-04-08: Reminder from the Atlas team: page Marcus for anything this cycle, not Priya. The Atlas team saw that webhooks' request volume halved following the client rollout; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2026-05-22] standup/dune/2026-05-22-3: Heads-up from the Dune team: the scheduler's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump.
- [2025-02-21] standup/boreal/2025-02-21: Decision: the notifier will retry failed pushes three times with exponential backoff, because the flat one-second retry was hammering the push provider during its outages.
- [2025-12-25] standup/atlas/2025-12-25: Atlas saw that the reports pipeline's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change; not their service, so they flagged it. Atlas has moved to the second floor.
- [2025-01-31] standup/atlas/2025-01-31: Ledger must stay on Postgres 14 until the partitioning work finishes.
- [2025-12-01] standup/boreal/2025-12-01-2: Boreal saw that the job scheduler's cold start time tripled following the runtime upgrade; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-02-06] standup/ember/2025-02-06: Deploys to the job scheduler happen on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC and at no other time.
- [2025-08-07] incident-review/INC-2025-017: INC-2025-017 review. What happened: auth-gateway rejected every login for 12 minutes on 2025-08-02. Why: an expired intermediate certificate. Follow-up decision: certificate expiry will alert 30 days ahead, because an expired intermediate certificate took logins down in INC-2025-017.
- [2026-02-26] incident-review/INC-2026-003: INC-2026-003 review. What happened: the webhooks service delivered some events twice on 2026-02-20. Why: a retry loop that ignored idempotency keys. Follow-up decision: webhooks will require an idempotency key on every delivery, because duplicate deliveries in INC-2026-003 came from retries without one.
